summary: The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) summarizes the concerns raised by parents, teachers, and child development professionals during a virtual listening session on screen-based instruction in K-12 schools and the Federal Communication Commission’s review of E-Rate. The overwhelming weight of testimony was critical of routine screen-based instruction and the widespread use of one-to-one devices and EdTech products in K-12 schools. The stakeholders argue that E-Rate should condition decisions on screen-time limits, parental consent, and the quality of educational technology.
